newsitem.title: UK: Jefferson Smurfit plans U.S. disposals - paper.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson Smurfit plans U.S. disposals - paper.

text.p: Irish paper and packaging group Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc is planning a review of its U.S. operations which may result in major disposals, according to the Sunday Telegraph.

The review of the group's 47 percent owned U.S. associate Jefferson Smurfit Corporation, which is said to be nearing completion, could also mean the departure of Morgan Stanley as a key investor, the paper said.
Morgan Stanley's 34 percent stake in JS corporation, worth $700 million, may be disposed of through a secondary offering or a distribution of shares to its shareholders.
The two moves are expected to bring greater stability and focus to Smurfit, and boost the company's share price, the newspaper said. Shares closed on Friday at 185.5 pence.
No-one at the company could be immediately contacted for comment.
